subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be a new `dmThreadMode` account option, part of the existing `replyToMode` threading contract, or remain disabled for DMs?
rationale: The PR adds new config surface and re-enables a previously suppressed Google Chat API path; automation cannot choose the permanent product/API contract or accept the message-delivery risk without maintainer intent.

options.title: Fold into existing threading contract
options.body: Treat DM threading as part of Google Chat's existing `replyToMode`/threading model and avoid a separate account key unless that contract cannot express the behavior.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` as a new knob
options.body: Keep the separate opt-in, but require exported types, generated metadata, docs/help, upgrade semantics, and inspectable real Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Keep DMs unthreaded
options.body: Decline the opt-in and preserve the prior safe default unless live Google Chat evidence shows DM thread targets are valid for the intended deployments.

recommendation.title: Fold into existing threading contract
recommendation.body: Treat DM threading as part of Google Chat's existing `replyToMode`/threading model and avoid a separate account key unless that contract cannot express the behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They verified and completed the prior DM-thread suppression fix and have the strongest recent history on the Google Chat monitor/API path.
